hero.title: Land, world and memory — six gazes

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.description: How EnredArte collects, uses, and protects your personal data.

sections.heading: Data controller
sections.body: EnredArte, based in Mexico City, Mexico, controls your personal data. Contact: info@enredarte.com and +52 624 176 4802.

sections.heading: Data we collect
sections.body: We collect your name, email, phone, and the details of your inquiry about works or purchases, only through the contact channels you use.

sections.heading: Purposes
sections.body: Your data is used to answer inquiries, support artwork reservations or purchases, and — with your consent — share news about rooms and artists.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access, correction, deletion, or objection regarding your data at info@enredarte.com. We respond under applicable law.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.description: Terms for inquiring about and purchasing works at EnredArte.

sections.heading: Originality and certificate
sections.body: Each work is original and ships with its signed certificate of authenticity (COA).

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: Prices are shown in Mexican pesos (MXN). When a price is listed on request, we quote you personally.

sections.heading: Artist share
sections.body: 65% of each work's price goes to the artist.

sections.heading: Shipping
sections.body: Shipping is insured via DHL or FedEx. Timing and costs are confirmed before purchase.

sections.heading: Reservations and returns
sections.body: Reservations are confirmed in writing. If a work does not match its description, write to info@enredarte.com or +52 624 176 4802 and we will find a solution.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: Which cookies EnredArte uses and how to manage them.

sections.heading: Which cookies we use
sections.body: We use strictly necessary cookies, preference cookies (such as language), and analytics cookies to understand visits to rooms and works.

sections.heading: Purposes
sections.body: Cookies show content in your language, remember your collection filters, and improve browsing.

sections.heading: How to manage them
sections.body: You can accept or reject non-necessary cookies and change your choice at any time in your browser settings.
